capability.untrustedWorkspaces: Chat remains available. Agent file writes and command execution require a trusted workspace.
command.continueConversation: Continue current task history in a new chat
config.apiProfiles: API profile list. Keys are never written here; each profile keeps its key in VS Code SecretStorage.
config.model: Default model. Can be switched from the chat panel header at any time.
config.requestHeaders: Extra headers sent to the compatible endpoint. Authorization is filled in from the API key.
config.maxTokens: Maximum tokens per reply; 0 lets the server decide.
config.systemPrompt: System prompt prepended to every conversation. Left empty, nothing is sent.
config.sendOnEnter: Enter sends the message; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
config.historyRetentionDays: Days to keep unpinned conversations; 0 never expires them by age.
config.taskCacheRetentionHours: Hours to keep heavy payloads (reasoning, usage, tool details, attachment bodies) for finished tasks. Afterwards the reply and step summary remain. 0 trims immediately.
config.cacheBudgetMB: Total history size budget. The oldest unpinned conversations are evicted first.
config.maxMessagesInContext: Maximum number of history messages sent to the model, so the context cannot grow without bound. 0 means unlimited.
config.defaultMode.enum1: Can read, modify files and run commands within the permission policy
config.defaultMode.enum2: Read-only analysis and planning; the workspace is never modified
config.agentMaxSteps: Maximum tool-call rounds per agent turn for new conversations. Defaults to 24, with four presets: 24 / 68 / 120 / unlimited (0). Nothing can exceed 200 (0 is the explicit unlimited sentinel; negative or invalid values fall back to the default).
config.agentMaxSteps.deprecated: Deprecated: this value no longer affects anything. Every new conversation starts at 24 steps; pick 24 / 68 / 120 / unlimited in the composer for the current conversation.
config.reasoningEffort: Reasoning depth for chat requests. Four levels: low / medium / high / max. DeepSeek's official API accepts all four (medium is mapped to high server-side); other OpenAI-compatible endpoints have no max level and receive high instead.
config.reasoningEffort.deprecated: Deprecated: this value no longer affects anything. Every new conversation starts at the model’s official default (no reasoning parameters are sent); choose a depth in the composer for the current conversation. Kept for old settings files and for discovering model capabilities.
config.reasoningEffort.enumDefault: Default: send no reasoning parameters and let the model use its official default
config.permissionPreset: Agent permission preset. Only a default for new conversations (Ask every time), and switching it in the panel affects the current conversation until you switch again. An untrusted workspace and path isolation outside the workspace are hard limits that no preset can disable.
config.permissionPreset.deprecated: Deprecated: this value no longer affects anything. Every new conversation always starts from “Ask every time”; change the preset in the composer for the current conversation and it is stored with that conversation.
config.permissionPreset.enum0: Reads, writes, read-only commands and regular commands all require confirmation; dangerous commands are denied; sensitive files are blocked
config.permissionPreset.enum1: Reads, writes, read-only commands and regular commands run automatically; dangerous commands require confirmation; sensitive files are blocked
config.permissionPreset.enum2: Reads, writes, read-only commands, regular commands and dangerous commands all run automatically; sensitive files are blocked
config.permissionPreset.enum3: Reads, writes, read-only commands, regular commands and dangerous commands all run automatically; reading sensitive files requires confirmation
config.fileReadPolicy: Policy applied before the agent reads workspace files. Display only: always decided by hwchat.permissionPreset.
config.fileReadPolicy.deprecated: Deprecated: derived from the current conversation's permission preset; manual changes have no effect.
config.fileWritePolicy: Policy applied before the agent modifies workspace files. Display only: always decided by hwchat.permissionPreset. Untrusted workspaces are always blocked.
config.fileWritePolicy.deprecated: Deprecated: derived from the current conversation's permission preset; manual changes have no effect.
config.commandPolicy: Policy for read-only and regular commands. Display only: always decided by hwchat.permissionPreset. Dangerous commands are governed separately; untrusted workspaces are always blocked.
config.commandPolicy.deprecated: Deprecated: derived from the current conversation's permission preset; manual changes have no effect.
config.dangerousCommandPolicy: Policy for dangerous commands (privilege escalation, destructive deletion, disk wiping, forced pushes, piping remote scripts into a shell). Display only: always decided by hwchat.permissionPreset.
config.dangerousCommandPolicy.deprecated: Deprecated: derived from the current conversation's permission preset; manual changes have no effect.
config.sensitiveFilePolicy: Policy for sensitive files (.env, keys, certificates and common credential paths). Display only: always decided by hwchat.permissionPreset.
config.sensitiveFilePolicy.deprecated: Deprecated: derived from the current conversation's permission preset; manual changes have no effect.
config.allowSensitiveFiles: Legacy toggle: same as setting the sensitive-file policy to allow or deny.
config.allowSensitiveFiles.deprecated: Superseded by hwchat.sensitiveFilePolicy; only used as a migration fallback when the new setting is absent.
config.allowDangerousCommands: Legacy toggle: on equals ask for dangerous commands, off equals deny.
config.allowDangerousCommands.deprecated: Superseded by hwchat.dangerousCommandPolicy; only used as a migration fallback when the new setting is absent.
config.maxReadBytes: Maximum bytes for a single file added to context or read.
config.maxToolOutputBytes: Maximum bytes of a single tool result sent to the model.
config.maxCommandSeconds: Maximum runtime for an agent command.
config.auditRetentionDays: Days to keep local agent audit records; 0 keeps only the current session.
config.language: Language for the HWChat interface and messages. Applies to the chat panel, settings page, notifications and errors.
config.language.enum0: Follow the VS Code display language
config.searchExclude: Extra directory names to exclude from HWChat's workspace search, in addition to the built-in list (.git, node_modules, dist, build, out, coverage, .next, .turbo, .venv, venv, __pycache__, DerivedData, .cache).
command.showResourceStats: Show active/queued searches and running commands (for diagnosing CPU or EAGAIN issues)
